hash_policy.worktree_sha256: sha256 of the exact bytes on disk
hash_policy.git_blob_oid: git hash-object --path=<path> <path> (blob id after the repository clean filter)
hash_policy.eol: crlf|lf marker per file; EOL-only worktree/blob differences are declared, never called tampering

export_restore.export_blob: git show <commit>:<path>  (exact committed bytes; LF under autocrlf=true)
export_restore.export_worktree_bytes: read the file from a checkout with the recorded core.autocrlf; verify worktree_sha256
export_restore.restore: git checkout -- <path> from the named commit restores the recorded worktree bytes for this configuration; do not renormalize the repo
